describe: The image shows a wall of bright orange, peeling painted metal with rust streaks, a dark slot window near the top centre, and a riveted metal door panel in the middle. Along the bottom, grey-tan stone blocks with mortar lines form a crumbling masonry base, with broken top edges and gaps where the orange paint has flaked away. Colours are vivid orange, dull steel grey and pale stone. Lighting is even and fairly bright. This is a texture sheet of a few large pieces, so every piece must stay exactly in place.
